The binomial coefficients for $n=3$ are: $\binom{3}{0}=1, \binom{3}{1}=3, \binom{3}{2}=3, \binom{3}{3}=1$.

If we sum the product of **consecutive** terms from the same row (i.e., $k$ and $k+1$):
$$ S = \binom{n}{0}\binom{n}{1} + \binom{n}{1}\binom{n}{2} + \dots $$

Sum $= 3 + 9 + 3 = 15$.
